audit.boundedness: discovered_by_key can contribute at most MAX_COMPILED_RELATIONS selected signatures; the temporary set is built once after admission, not once per edge or binding
findings: GPU-122 already makes discovered_by_key the canonical per-three-field interning owner, so the values are unique for the current compile_relation_blocks caller.
_selected_signatures currently declares discovered as set[RelationSignature]; that private contract guarantees uniqueness independently of whichever discover caller supplies it.
Deleting only this set requires broadening the helper to an arbitrary iterable/dict-values contract or duplicating the existing boundedness and deterministic sort logic beside the helper.

Broadening the helper would make duplicate discovered inputs silently possible for future private callers unless duplicate validation is reintroduced, while duplicating the sort/bound path would create exactly the parallel selection logic this campaign is avoiding.
Unlike GPU-114/115/117/118/122, this candidate is a single bounded post-admission container materialization rather than repeated per-record construction or duplicate normalization work.
audit.reason: The bounded temporary set is currently the smaller invariant-preserving design. Removing it would trade one <=4096-entry temporary container for a weaker selector contract or duplicated selection logic, neither of which is justified by measured evidence.

baseline.reconciliation: non-force two-parent merge; main only added the G2 tensor census preregistration/reader/runner files relative to the common base, so the GPU-121/122 code/test evidence was retained unchanged

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

next_candidate: Move away from tuple/container micro-edits and use the existing relation-construction diagnostics to select the next repeated or retained-memory bucket. Prefer an existing-owner delete/reuse; close negatively if the change needs a second staging/selection abstraction.
objective: Audit whether the one-shot set(discovered_by_key.values()) materialization at the discover-all selection boundary can be deleted without weakening the private selector invariant, duplicating ordering/bound logic, or introducing another selection abstraction.

migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet is a read-only audit: it deletes no code and adds none, so there is nothing to migrate and a revert would remove only the record. authority_and_claims asserts explicitly that no authority was changed, nothing was promoted and no benchmark or performance win is claimed.
